commits.message:
Add basic style.css and references in every html

Add style.css file. Link every html file to it.
Add css class to html elements. Add basic style properties to style.css.

Create file structure, add index page, add 2 recipes

Create basic structure for odin-recipes lesson. Create index page with
link list to recipes. Add first 2 recipes pages, populate them with
content and link them to index.
Initial commit

Add more content and footer

Add second, third and four content areas and a footer in html. Populate
and style them.

Create header and first content area, Add font ref

Create header and first content area in index.html. Populate them with
elements and add style in css. Add "Roboto" font links in index.html
head and apply the font to some elements in style.css.
Add index.html with boilerplate and style.css
Initial commit

Add basic html/js UI to the game

The game was played through browser prompts and
console messages, without possibility to replay.
This commit adds basic html/js UI with buttons,
text elements, game reset functionality and adapts
game logic to click event listeners.

Write main game logic in script.js

In script.js, declare functions getPlayerChoice(), getComputerChoice(),
playRound() and playGame(), the basic algorithms to play a game of n
rounds of Rock, Paper, Scissors against the computer and determine a
winner. Show outputs through console.log().

Add Pseudocode to script.js

Add Pseudocode of the main algorithms to be used in script.js.

Add index.html and script.js

Add index.html with boilerplate. Add script.js. Link script.js to
index.html in <body>.
Initial commit

Add grid toggle

Add grid toggle button to menu and implement logic
to hide grid by making pixels' border color equal
to bgColor.

Update rainbowBtn UI

Change position of rainbowBtn in menu. Toggling it
now also changes paintColor background to a
rainbow gradient.

Add Pen size functionality

Add input slider to select penSize. Implement
functionality in paint() by checking for adjacent
pixels using pixels' textContent, which is added
during pixel creation but hidden in UI (.pixel
font.size: 0). Limit max resolution on
resizeCanvas() to avoid performance issues.

Add erase function and button

Add erase toggle and implement into paint() logic.
Add erase button to menu.

Fix header formatting on small window size

Avoid header text to be multiline on small window
sizes by setting min-width.

Add paint color and background color switches

Add paintColorBtn and bgColorBtn color input
elements to the menu and implement functionality.
Implement rgb to Hex conversion functions inside
background color functions, to allow comparing
between retrieved rgb color values with input Hex
color values.

Fix painting logic not drawing on first pixel

Painting functionality was not working on the
initial pixel clicked.
Move painting functionality into paint(e) and
fix event listeners logic.

Add header

Add header area and adapt style to accomodate
it.

Add mouseClicked variable to enable painting

Painting on canvas is now enabled on mousedown
and disabled on mouseup.

Add Clear and Rainbow functions and restyle menu

Add clearCanvas function to reset pixels' color.
Add rainbow boolean to toggle painting in a
random color. Add buttons for both
new functionalities and restyle menu to accomodate
multiple items.

Add menu bar and canvas resize funcionality

Add menu bar on the left side. Modify canvas
creation function to allow parameters for size
and resolution. Add resize UI to the menu.

Add drawing canvas functionality

Implement creation of canvas area with the desired
resolution and event listener to draw on it, add
basic css.
Create style.css
Create index.html and script.js
Initial commit
